title: Installing Git
overview: Git needs to be installed on the system before using Git commands for version control.

title: Git Configuration
overview: Git configuration stores user information used for identifying commits.

example.title: Configure Git User
example.content:
git config --global user.name "Your Name"

git config --global user.email "email@example.com"

title: Git Configuration Levels
overview: Git provides different configuration levels to control settings globally or for specific repositories.

example.title: Configuration Levels
example.content:
System:
All users

Global:
Current user

Local:
Current repository

title: Creating First Git Repository
overview: A Git repository is created inside a project folder to start tracking file changes.

title: Checking Repository Status
overview: Git status shows the current state of files and changes inside a repository.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to install Git, configure user details, create repositories, and check repository status.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
